name, supplier_type, owner_user, status, mobile, email, detail_address, pay_type, remark, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted,
#{name}, #{supplierType}, #{ownerUser}, #{status}, #{mobile}, #{email}, #{detailAddress}, #{payType}, #{remark}, #{creator}, #{createTime}, #{updater}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted},
mapper.delete: update crm_supplier set deleted = 1 where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select id,name from crm_supplier where deleted=0 and status=1

select agg.supplier_id as supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, p.id, p.name, p.no, p.product_code, p.type, p.source, p.price_detail, p.status, p.description, agg.min_cost_discount, agg.max_cost_discount, agg.min_sell_discount, agg.max_sell_discount from ( select supplier_id, project_id, min(min_cost_discount) as min_cost_discount, max(max_cost_discount) as max_cost_discount, min(min_sell_discount) as min_sell_discount, max(max_sell_discount) as max_sell_discount from crm_supplier_project group by supplier_id, project_id ) agg inner join crm_supplier s on s.id = agg.supplier_id and s.deleted = 0 and s.status = 1 inner join crm_model_product p on agg.project_id = p.id where p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 order by agg.supplier_id, p.id
